newsitem.title: USA: Christine Varney to step down from FTC - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Christine Varney to step down from FTC - WSJ.

text.p: The Federal Trade Commission's Christine Varney plans to step down in August to build an Internet-law practice at a Washington law firm, The Wall Street Journal said.
In Wednesday's electronic edition, the paper said Varney, a strong pro-business voice on the FTC, was at times the crucial third vote for Chairman Robert Pitofsky on the five-member commission.
The newspaper said Varney plans to join the firm of Hogan & Hartson in September.
The newspaper said she recently browbeat Internet and commercial database companies into devising privacy protections, making it clear the FTC would do it if the companies did not.
